name: Sparse Voxel Octree for Indirect Illumination
definition: A pre-filtered hierarchical voxel representation of scene geometry stored as a dynamic sparse voxel octree on the GPU, used to efficiently estimate visibility and integrate incoming indirect energy without involving the actual mesh.
summary: This GPU-based method uses a pre-filtered sparse voxel octree to estimate visibility and integrate indirect energy, offering real-time, noise-free specular lighting without temporal discontinuities.
